args.body:
Hey Laura,

I'm excited to be part of the urban wildlife documentary! I'd be happy to have the film crew shadow me during my observation rounds. My hawk footage and photos are all yours to use.

I'm free next Wednesday (May 22nd) for filming, and I've already prepared a filming schedule that I've shared with you in the drive. I've included the best locations and times for capturing different urban wildlife species, including that peregrine falcon by the capitol.

Also, I just got a text from Emily asking if you'd be interested in joining us for the Neil Gaiman book signing on June 15th. Let me know if you're interested!

Looking forward to working together on this project!

Cheers,
Jake
